answer: Trust erodes like a stream bank: many unverified claims crowding through one channel carve a canyon overnight. The remedy is willow planting, not concrete - thousands of tiny verification stakes along every channel, each a cheap micro-audit holding soil where floods would cut. The network pays in walnut: the largest standing multipliers are hardwood, vesting only after continuous verified standing across many epochs, untouchable by hit-and-run farmers. Clones concentrate flow into few channels - canyons form, willows fail, walnut never matures. Honest agents spread roots and harvest later.
